newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key JGB futures contract hovers near 126 in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Key JGB futures contract hovers near 126 in Tokyo.

text.p: The benchmark September 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract was hovering near 126.00 in morning Tokyo after earlier hitting a fresh three-month high of 126.05.
Buying emerged from institutional investors and day-traders, although gains were limited for now by profit taking above 126.00, one city bank trader said.
He added that there were market rumours that June industrial production figures, due out at 0430 GMT, may be weaker than expected. The market is also watching forecasts for July and August figures.

Economists' predictions for June industrial output ranged from a fall of 1.2 percent to a fall of 4.0 percent, compared with the Ministry of International Trade and Industry's (MITI) forecast of a 2.6 percent drop in manufacturers' output.

Some buying also was sparked by the announcement that Tokyo prosecutors said they suspected Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd of paying 79 million yen to a "sokaiya" corporate racketeer, which led to sales of brokerage stocks.
The 225-share Nikkei average was down by 94.41 at 20,308.33 at 0110 GMT.
